searchText: No, but you must call it before importing ethereum or its submodules. Hm, I confirmed the optimized `set_account` is being called, but I don't see any improvement in performance in the early blocks. Not entirely sure I should even _see_ an improvement until later on Looks like half the time is spent in the ethash code, at least in cpython. There seems to be a bug somewhere in the gas calculation 😦 Block 50111 doesn't validate. https://github.com/SamWilsn/eth1.0-specs/blob/chain-sync/src/ethereum_spec_tools/sync.py If anyone wants to take a peak 😛 could be something to do with jump dest analysis? i printed out the ops it's a `JUMPI` that causes the fault seems like something is up with the optimized db - an `SLOAD(3)` is returning `0` in the spec and `6` in erigon My local node is Erigon, which doesn't seem to support `debug_getBlockRlp`. Is there a way to test this without syncing a Geth node first? Oof. Was hoping that one wasn't geth specific 😐 I'll port <@!497280885645639691>'s code that uses `eth_getBlockByNumber` over, but that'll have to wait until Tuesday. Syncing frontier is pretty quick though ._. I couldn't get Geth to allow `debug_getBlockRlp` during sync. Didn't try very hard though. completely anecdotal, but scrolling the logs i haven't see an SSTORE that has persisted across txs SSTOREs not persisting across txs is something that is very plausibly broken and untested in the optimized state. Fixed https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/368 awesome thanks! that has advanced us to block 54319! What're we hitting now? Ah, something in the receipts I guess: ``` ensure(receipt_root == block.header.receipt_root) ``` This is a bookkeeping error about destroyed accounts in the optimized state. Will fix tomorrow. This line almost always means the state root is wrong.
